rules.rule: `canary` or `linear` requires `rollback: alarm`
`canary`/`linear` need `steps` rising and ending at 100, and `bake_minutes` >= 1
`delivery: gitops` only for a runtime whose `gitops` capability is true (`eks-workload`)
(runtime, strategy, engine) must be in the compatibility matrix
canary, linear or blue-green on a runtime that needs an ALB for gradual release (`ecs-fargate`, `ec2-asg`) need `front_door: alb`
ALB needed and `budget.monthly_usd` < 40
`blue-green` doubles capacity during a deploy

A runtime limit from compat `limits` is exceeded (Lambda: `max_duration_seconds` > 900, `max_payload_mb` > 6) or `needs` contains something the runtime cannot provide (Lambda: gpu, os, licence, websockets)
`front_door: http-api` with `max_duration_seconds` > 29
A 12-digit number anywhere in the manifest text, including comments and placeholders
A `tier: prod` env needs `promote_from` (one artifact promoted by digest)
`database.kind != none` and a strategy that runs two versions at once (per the runtime's `two_versions_live`) needs `database.schema_change: expand-contract`
`dr.rto_minutes` < 60 with `backup-restore`, or < 10 without warm-standby or multi-site
`warm-standby` or `multi-site` with `budget.monthly_usd` < 100
A runtime with a fixed monthly cost (`eks-workload` control plane) and `budget.monthly_usd` < 100
`scale_to_zero` or `fargate_spot` on a `tier: prod` env
Runtime, engine, delivery or deploy role profile not built yet, or `ci.provider: codepipeline`. A warning under `--context lint`, an error under `--context deploy`
A `tier: prod` env with `rollback: manual` and a strategy other than all-at-once
`canary` or `linear` needs `release.probes` with at least one path other than `workload.health_path`
`promote_from` names an existing, different env; the promote graph is acyclic; account labels are distinct across envs
An env flag (`scale_to_zero`, `fargate_spot`) must be in the runtime's `env_flags`
A `tier: prod` env needs `compliance.data_class`; `data_class: regulated` needs `kms_cmk: true`
A `tier: prod` env needs `dr.rto_minutes` and `dr.rpo_minutes`
A `tier: prod` env needs `workload.peak_rps` and `workload.p95_ms`
`envs.<e>.region` must be in `defaults.json` `allowed_regions` (Phase 1: `ap-southeast-1`)
